description: Apply for Scripting TestFlight access by providing a purchase receipt, Pro status screenshot, and App Store five-star review screenshot. Receipt OCR extracts the Apple ID email and order number, then opens a prefilled Mail draft with all required attachments.

localizedDescriptions.zh: 通过购买收据、Pro 状态页面和 App Store 五星短评截图申请 Scripting TestFlight 测试资格。收据 OCR 会识别 Apple ID 邮箱和订单号，并生成包含全部附件的邮件草稿。
localizedDescriptions.en: Apply for Scripting TestFlight access with a purchase receipt, Pro status screenshot, and App Store five-star review screenshot. Receipt OCR extracts the Apple ID email and order number, then prepares a Mail draft with all required attachments.

name: Apply Scripting TestFlight
